tasks.title: StatusTransition model and indexes
tasks.description: server/src/models/statusTransitionModel.ts: one row per move with workspace, task, project name, sprint, type, from, to, at and actor, indexed by { workspace, at } and { workspace, task, at } and kept without a TTL so the charts reach back as far as the data does.

tasks.title: Flow tracking listener on the activity stream
tasks.description: server/src/utils/flow/register.ts: registerFlowTracking subscribes once per process and trackStatusTransition writes the row for task.created and status-changing task.updated of top-level non-epic tasks; server/src/app.ts calls it before the automation and webhook listeners.

tasks.title: Metrics module with timelines and the four measures
tasks.description: server/src/utils/flow/metrics.ts: dayKey, parseDayKey, makeRange, buildTimelines with its backfill rules, cumulativeFlow, percentile (nearest rank), cycleTimes, leadTimes, agingWip, isoWeekLabel, throughput and buildFlowReport.

tasks.title: Unit tests for the metrics module
tasks.description: server/src/__tests__/flowMetrics.test.ts covering day keys and ranges, the timeline backfill, the cumulative counts, the percentiles, cycle versus lead time, throughput weeks and the aging order.

tasks.title: getFlowReport handler with strict query parsing
tasks.description: server/src/controllers/flowController.ts: queryString rejection of arrays and objects, the project/sprint/date rules, the 180-day cap, the default 30-day range, the task and transition queries scoped to the workspace, the assignee lookup for the aging list and the JSON payload.

tasks.title: Route registration with the project permission
tasks.description: GET /:slug/reports/flow declared on server/src/routes/workspaceRoutes.ts behind protect and requirePermission('projects:read').

tasks.title: Client flow API, types and loading hook
tasks.description: client/src/features/flow/types.ts, api.ts and hooks/useFlowReport.ts: the payload shapes, the request through the shared axios instance, and loading/error state keyed to the filter set.

tasks.title: Presentation helpers with text alternatives
tasks.description: client/src/features/flow/lib/flow.ts: range presets and rangeFor, stack order, axisScale, cfdMax, stackBands, areaPath, labelIndexes, agingLevel and AGING_META, countOverP85, isEmptyReport, describeCfd and describeStats, plus hooks/useActiveIndex and hooks/useChartWidth.

tasks.title: The four flow charts and the panel
tasks.description: CumulativeFlowChart, TimeScatterChart, ThroughputChart, AgingWipList and ChartParts, assembled by FlowReportPanel with the filters, the summary cards and the cycle/lead switch.

tasks.title: Flow tab on the Reports page
tasks.description: client/src/pages/ReportsPage.tsx mounts FlowReportPanel as ?tab=flow, only when the role holds projects:read, keeping the URL as the source of the selected tab.

tasks.title: Client tests for the helpers and the panel
tasks.description: client/src/features/flow/__tests__/flow.test.ts for the pure helpers and FlowReportPanel.test.tsx for the panel's states, plus the shared fixtures.
